import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.status').get('observe') is None:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 180.0, app.actions.run('train.status')
    app.update(True)
print('SERVING', app.actions.run('train.status')['observe'])

import builtins
from nuka.editor.app import ActionError
links = [n['path'] for n in app.actions.run('scene.nodes', under='${robot.focus}', kind='body')]
builtins.observe_hash = app.document()['hash']
app.actions.run('edit.apply', label='Mass', ops=[{'target': links[1], 'field': 'body.mass', 'after': 3.0}])
for _ in range(2):
    app.update(True)
assert app.document()['hash'] != builtins.observe_hash, links
try:
    app.actions.run('train.observe', on=True)
except ActionError as e:
    assert 'scene differs' in str(e), e
else:
    raise AssertionError('an edited scene was watched')

o = ${o0}
assert o['on'] and o['name'] == 'watch' and o['envs'] == 16 and o['run_envs'] == 256 and o['spacing'] == 1.0, o
assert o['terrain'] and o['terrain']['nrow'] > 2 and o['terrain']['cell_x'] > 0.0, o
assert o['lift'] == 0.0, o
assert app.actions.run('view.envs')['show'] == 16 and app.actions.run('view.envs')['count'] == 16

import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.observe')['frames'] < 2:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 30.0, app.actions.run('train.observe')
    app.update(True)
a = app.actions.run('train.observe')
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.observe')['frames'] < a['frames'] + 6:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 30.0, app.actions.run('train.observe')
    app.update(True)
b = app.actions.run('train.observe')
moved = max(abs(p - q) for x, y in zip(a['arrows'], b['arrows']) for p, q in zip(x['at'], y['at']))
print('OBSERVED', b['frames'] - a['frames'], 'frames', b['steps'] - a['steps'], 'steps', 'moved', round(moved, 3), 'lift', round(b['lift'], 3))
assert 0.35 < b['lift'] < 0.7, b['lift']
assert len(b['arrows']) == 16 and b['steps'] > a['steps'], (a, b)
assert moved > 0.01 and any(abs(v) > 0.05 for x in b['arrows'] for v in x['command'][:2]), b['arrows']

import math
for _ in range(90):
    app.update(True)
o = app.actions.run('train.observe')
at = o['arrows'][0]['at']
target = app.actions.run('view.camera')['target']
gap = math.dist(target, [at[0], at[1], at[2] - o['lift']])
print('FOLLOW', round(gap, 3))
assert gap < 0.6, (target, at)

c = app.actions.run('view.camera')
app.actions.run('view.camera', target=c['target'], distance=2.5, yaw=35.0, pitch=22.0)
for _ in range(30):
    app.update(True)

import time
t = time.monotonic()
while app.actions.run('train.observe')['on']:
    assert time.monotonic() - t < 180.0, app.actions.run('train.status')
    app.update(True)
